description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeReportToController class, which manages the presentation and permissions logic related to employee 'report to' reporting configurations within the HRM system. It primarily prepares data for rendering the employee report-to component, fetching reporting methods via a service, and setting relevant permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeReportToController
classes.description: Controller class managing the employee report-to configuration component, including preparing data for UI rendering and permission checks.

methods.name: getReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with reporting methods data based on the employee number retrieved from the request, and sets necessary permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for permission capability checks.
